tools.name: payment_info
tools.description: Read the documented SML x402 v2 Base/USDC configuration and receiver before selecting a paid route. Returns configuration and a read-only policy. Fresh resource requirements override these hints; this tool does not sign, spend or prove settlement.

tools.name: list_paid_apis
tools.description: List paid API operations declared by the live SqueezeOS OpenAPI document, bounded by limit. Returns method, path, job and advertised price. Use for route selection, then inspect that resource's fresh 402 challenge; listed prices do not authorize payment.

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Inspect a public HTTPS URL for a fresh x402 v2 HTTP 402 challenge using an unsigned GET with a 10-second network timeout and no redirect following. Returns validated payTo, asset, network, atomic amount, resource and maxTimeoutSeconds; incomplete or non-x402 responses return challenge=null and a rea

tools.name: x402_inspect_challenge
tools.description: Inspect a fresh x402 v2 challenge without sending payment. Compatible alias of check_payment with the same schema, 10-second unsigned probe and result. Use before a paid resource call; do not use as a signer, receipt verifier or settlement proof. Non-402 and incomplete challenges remain null rather

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Read the current SqueezeOS backend status and payment-readiness evidence. Returns both upstream envelopes and autonomous_spend=false. Use to diagnose readiness before purchase; HTTP availability or readiness flags alone do not establish settled or accepted delivery.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "payment_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
